About Susan

Where Science Meets the Sacred

I work at the intersection of energy, body, and consciousness — combining Master-level Reiki, Energy Medicine, and Clinical Hypnotherapy to create lasting shifts in the nervous system and subconscious mind.


My practice is a sanctuary for high-end, discreet, results-oriented healing. With over 15 years of experience, I've worked with clients from around the world — from corporate executives seeking relief to individuals navigating profound life transitions.
